title: Biomarkers for Noise-Induced Sleep Disruption
description: This project aims to investigate gene expression biomarkers for noise-induced sleep disruption and cognitive changes. The project is a sub-study, part of the larger ASCENT COE project 86 designed to test the ability of broadband pink noise to serve as a countermeasure for sleep loss from simulated aircraft noise. Gene expression research was sponsored by the Federal Aviation Administration.
